mapper.sql: id, agent_run_id, step_number, step_type, title, status, model_call_id, tool_call_id, input_summary, output_summary, started_at, finished_at, error_code, error_summary, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_run_step ( agent_run_id, step_number, step_type, title, status, model_call_id, tool_call_id, input_summary, output_summary, started_at, finished_at, error_code, error_summary, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{agentRunId}, #{stepNumber}, #{stepType}, #{title}, #{status}, #{modelCallId}, #{toolCallId}, #{inputSummary}, #{outputSummary}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{errorCode}, #{errorSummary}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_run_step WHERE agent_run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY step_number, id
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run_step SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', output_summary = #{outputSummary}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE agent_run_step SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_summary = #{errorSummary}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
